answer: Bind each agent to one physical SIM verified by the carrier, like a quill signing in violet ink. Step one, at enrollment the agent registers its SIM and the carrier attests the number is unique and active. Step two, each epoch the carrier sends an SMS challenge the agent must answer within five minutes. Step three, a SIM missing two challenges is cut from the thread of trust and its bond is slashed. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 live SIMs at about $5 each a month, $5,000 a month plus phones and logistics. One quill writes one signature, one SIM carries one agent, and a fake has no ink.
